result:
My part of round 181 (M1) is done: the Transport Play button is now a 32×32 round button that shows only an icon. The browser checks have not run yet, so M1 is not done until C passes them.

I changed only the 6 allowed files and created doc 149. `git status` shows exactly those 7 files, and every other file still matches B's frozen list (999 files).

**What changed:**
- **Button:** `ArrangementTransport.tsx` now uses `w-8 rounded-full px-0` instead of `w-24`. The "Play"/"Pause" text labels are gone; the icons are unchanged.
- **Name and tooltip:** the accessible name is still exactly `Play` / `Pause`. A new tooltip reads `Play (Space)` / `Pause (Space)`. Both come from four new entries in `studioPlaybackStrings`.
- **Tests:**
  - `strings.test.ts` expects the four new strings.
  - In TS1, Play must be `rounded-full` and the other 11 buttons `rounded-md`.
  - In TS2, the button must contain no text, the tooltip is checked, and the old width and radius must be absent.
  - No assertion was removed.
- **Docs:** I closed the stale TODOs in doc 147 and doc 148 and set doc 148 to Completed. Doc 149 (in Georgian) is marked "awaiting C round 181".

**Checks I ran:**
- **Targeted tests:** the 15 targeted test files pass 229/229 both before and after the edits.
- **Typecheck and lint:** both pass. Lint reports 218 warnings across the repo, none in my files, and Biome is clean on the 4 code and test files.
- **Mutations:** all five deliberate breakages (m299–m303) failed exactly the tests the task expected, and each file was restored and hash-checked afterwards.
- **Not run:** the full suite, `npm run verify` and the e2e smoke run, which the speed rules leave to the root gate, so that part of `/check` is still open there.

**Code review:** the code-reviewer subagent found nothing Critical, High or Medium. It had no shell, so it checked my saved diff against the live files. Its Architecture note, verbatim: "none. The diff adds no state, effect, ref, listener or coupling…; the repeated fake AudioContext / ResizeObserver mount is already in B's checkpoint request (Q2 / ROOT-RECON-GRID-HARNESS)." It raised three Lows; one went away when I wrote the report. The other two, plus one suggestion, are for B because fixing them needs edits outside what this task allowed:
- The TS1 test title still says "8 px radius", which is no longer true for Play.
- TS1 looks up the Play button twice.
- Play could get `aria-keyshortcuts="Space"`, as the Zoom buttons do.

**Left for C:** all the browser checks at both viewports on `/studio-lab`: box size and radius, layout shift, screenshot diff, contrast, focus ring, brass scan, behaviour, accessibility, auth guard, and network/hydration. Two things to watch:
- **Layout:** the expected positions are B's simulation; I measured nothing in a browser.
- **Space key:** I didn't touch the Space handler. If Space or Enter on a focused Play button toggles twice, it does the same on HEAD and is a finding that already existed, not a round-181 failure.

Everything is in `/home/runner/czaba-project/tmp/studio-real-loop/`:
- `a-round-181.md` — the report
- `a-round-181/` — end hashes, test file list, the full diff, mutation results and the mutation script
